watch.name: meeting-with-lost-touch
watch.nl_query: The evening before, remind me if I have a meeting tomorrow with someone I haven't talked to in over a year.

nodes.comment: Entirely procedural. every_true is correct: the tick already caps evaluation at once a day.
nodes.query: SELECT count(*) > 0 AS fires, list(DISTINCT p.canonical_name) AS people, list(DISTINCT e.title) AS meetings FROM google_calendar_events e JOIN google_calendar_attendees a ON a.event_id = e.id JOIN people p ON p.id = a.person_id WHERE e.start_time::DATE = $today + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND NOT p.is_self AND (p.last_seen IS NULL OR p.last_seen < $now - INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
